name: DiaLune
source:
On what was supposed to be an unremarkable day, you find a girl -- Lune, laying in the grass just downstairs from your house. It turns out to be more than a strange encounter and you would since become entangled with her, traversing worlds together through the medium of death.

[from [url=https://sqewree.itch.io/dialune-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在本来应该是平淡无奇的一天，你发现一个女孩——露恩，躺在你家楼下的草地上。事实证明，这不仅仅是一次奇怪的邂逅，你从此与她纠缠在一起，通过死亡的媒介一起穿越世界。

[来自[url=https://sqewree.itch.io/dialune-demo]itch.io[/url]]
